name: DNSViz DNSSEC analysis pages
operator: DNSViz project (Sandia National Laboratories, Verisign Labs, Casey Deccio)
tier_rationale: Academic/research DNSSEC tool with a long public track record; P026 cond 5: 'trusted - DNSViz (Sandia/Verisign Labs)'. The footer credits Sandia (2010-14), Verisign (2014-16) and Casey Deccio (2016-23): the registry reviewer confirms the tier.

reliability.justification: Shows the last stored DNSSEC analysis; manual context only.

pivot_pages.title: DNSViz /d/{domain}/dnssec/ (manual pivot link)

terms.quote: The pack is offline data (disclosure 'none'): V3LUM never requests these URLs or any API behind them.

pivot_pages.notes: Quote: binding council text (cond 1 of the proposal). Research C0059 (verified 2026-11-26, 200, 'Updated: ...' stored analysis). The page's 'Update now'/'Analyze' button (GET /d/<domain>/analyze/) runs and publishes a fresh analysis: the link label warns about it (P026 cond 10) and no template points to /analyze/. Used by pivots_domain_dns (pack domain_dns.json).

notes: Manual pivot links only (batch p2-G14-1): V3LUM never fetches them (P311).
